projectDescription: A space-themed personal developer portfolio SPA built with React, TypeScript, Framer Motion, and Tailwind CSS, featuring animated orbital visuals, scrolling journey timelines, an interactive skills constellation, a project star map, case studies, a blog, and a contact form.
keyFeatures: Animated starfield background with parallax effect
Interactive 3D-like orbit system on the home page
Scroll-driven career journey timeline with planetary visuals
Draggable project star map with zoom controls
SVG skill constellation graph with hover interactions
Space-themed HUD UI components with cyan glow borders
Animated page transitions via Framer Motion AnimatePresence
Blog with signal-strength indicators and category icons
Space-themed contact form with transmission animation
Fully responsive with mobile navigation drawer
Monospace + serif font pairing (Space Mono + Fraunces)
publicApiSurface: Component: <Navigation /> — fixed HUD-style top navigation bar
Data array: projects (Zt) — id, name, type, x, y, size, color, desc, stack
Data array: skills (_) — id, name, color, nodes[], connections[]
Data array: workHistory (Kt) — id, role, company, stardate, status, debrief, tech[]
Data array: caseStudies — id, codename, client, status, summary, outcome, tags[]
Data array: blogPosts (as) — id, title, slug, date, category, signal, excerpt
Data array: testimonials (cs) — id, name, role, text, x, y, delay
CSS utility class: .hud-border — HUD-style border with cyan glow and backdrop blur
Tailwind color tokens: space-navy (#020617), space-turquoise (#22d3ee), space-teal (#14b8a6), space-white (#f1f5f9), space-violet (#7c3aed)
Custom animation: animate-ping-slow — slow pulsing ring effect
